calls.thesis: Shorts have it wrong and know it; BTC/ETH climbing and Clarity Act now has a path to passing -> COIN as equity proxy for digital-currency adoption.
calls.base_case: Base: tracks Bitcoin; up 32% in 3 months continues as crypto thaws.
calls.bull_case: Regulatory clarity + risk-on market -> short-fueled rally off 12% short interest.
calls.bear_case: Risk-off market drags crypto and COIN back down with it.
